title: WALKING IN CLOSE UNION

lines.text: I want to have my ears tuned so that I can hear,
And know its You that speaks to me
In the stillness of my heart.
Take me Lord and show me how,
To walk with You just You alone,
And in the cool of day
When I bow my head to pray,
Glad to be just praying Lord
And one day I will be
Well walk together hand in hand

lyrics:
[Chorus]
 Walking in close union
Like you did with Adam
Lord, you know my desire
To walk in sweet Communion.
[Verse]
[Verse]
I want to have my ears tuned so that I can hear,
And know its You that speaks to me
In the stillness of my heart.
So much confusion now
Take me Lord and show me how,
To walk with You just You alone,
Laying everything aside.
[Verse]
[Verse]
And in the cool of day
When I bow my head to pray,
Glad to be just praying Lord
Communing friend with friend,
And one day I will be
With you for eternity,
Well walk together hand in hand
And fellowship in love.
